scope: Twelve crisps from 140 g cheddar. Full fat retention is an upper estimate. The 1 g paprika is a documented bounded omission.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Fineli 698 is cheddar with 34.4 g fat per 100 g.
ingredients.edibleEvidence: Cheddar weighed as edible grated cheese.
ingredients.retentionEvidence: All fat modelled as retained. At 95% retention cheddar fat is 11.438 g per serving and at 90% it is 10.836 g.

ingredients.matchEvidence: Santa Maria EAN 7311311015243 is smoked paprika. https://www.s-kaupat.fi/tuote/santa-maria-37g-paprika-smoked-savupaprikajauhe/7311311015243
ingredients.excludedReason: The label declares fibre and macros but no polyols. Use a mass-bound omission for the 1 g batch rather than assign zero polyols.
ingredients.omissionImpactEvidence: 1 g across 4 servings is 0.25 g ingredient per serving. Each individual macro contribution is physically capped at 0.25 g; energy <=2.25 kcal at 9 kcal/g.
